resources.string: Draws the images you choose over the buttons of the 3-button navigation bar. Taps pass straight through to the real buttons. To know when the bar is showing, it only looks at the type, position and title of windows; it never reads what is inside them.
AnimNav is drawing over your navigation bar.
Follow the steps in Setup to turn it on.

1. Open App info → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings. This is only needed when the app was installed from a file.\n2. Open Accessibility settings → Installed apps → AnimNav → turn it on.\n3. In your navigation bar app (for example Good Lock NavStar), set the button icons to transparent images so the real icons don\'t show through.

Choose an image for each button: a GIF or WebP (animated is fine), a single PNG, or a ZIP of numbered PNG frames. If you don\'t set one for “Close keyboard”, the Back image is used while the keyboard is up.
Frame length for PNGs and PNG sequences: %d ms
Not a GIF, WebP, PNG or ZIP file
There are no PNG files in the ZIP
The image is too large (max %d px)
In fullscreen apps, Android reports the bar you swipe in a moment late, so the images slide in from the side after the bar is already up. Choose how they slide in.

Saved separately for small screens, large screens (600 dp wide or more, such as an unfolded foldable) and a side navigation bar (for example a cover screen in landscape). Open this app in the state you want to adjust. The defaults were measured on a Galaxy Z Fold7 with NavStar, so other devices will need adjusting.
Button order is Recents · Home · Back
In / out (+ moves toward the screen): %s

Don\'t use this in rhythm games or other apps that use touches at the screen edge. When it is on, and only while an app is fullscreen, thin invisible strips are placed on the screen edges (the navigation bar side, and the top edge when the status bar is hidden too). A swipe that starts in a strip is noticed right away, so the images start to appear together with the bar. Touches that start inside a strip don\'t reach the app. With alignment guides on, the strips show in red.
Tap here to open the keyboard

AnimNav only looks at the type, position and title of windows to know when the navigation bar is showing. It doesn\'t read what is on the screen, has no network access and collects nothing. The images you choose stay on this device.
